name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Support Specialist | Technical Troubleshooting, AI-Built Workflows & Documentation
summary: Customer-facing SaaS professional with 15+ years owning technical onboarding, troubleshooting, and support across CRM and marketing-automation platforms. Built and shipped AI-driven workflows that replaced manual, repetitive work, from a rubric-graded AI output pipeline to 20+ production automations, and personally writes and publishes newsletter content for a B2B audience. Comfortable owning escalations independently, documenting the fix so it doesn't recur, and building the reusable asset that saves the next person the same work.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system, 20+ production workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding, and lifecycle nurture, reusable assets the whole engagement runs on, not one-off fixes.

Configure and evaluate AI-generated output for client automation systems, building rubric-based grading criteria and personally labeling data to hold quality to a defined standard before it reaches a live account.

Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, working diligently to unblock clients on complex SaaS platforms and resolve technical issues in GoHighLevel and HubSpot CRM configurations.
Write and publish newsletter and thought-leadership content on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for a B2B audience.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping process records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation and marketing-automation tools, resolving issues directly rather than escalating them.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure through proactive account health tracking.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to escalate structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap, acting as the customer's advocate cross-functionally.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and cut repeat support questions.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, each a minimum $25K ARR account, while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Guided clients through Google Tag Manager setup and technical configuration as part of every launch.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations directly with the teams implementing them.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.
